proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived the original-record critical minimax frontier, finite-exact-level midpoint attainment, quantitative envelope, and sharp positive-length interval error order; a scoped second D0 round synchronized the strengthened headline and published-class transfer. After four primary-source attestations the mathematical panel passed, but the final novelty review and independent validity check confirmed subfield against the field floor (score ceiling 7.0 versus 7.4), with no bounded salvage. Formalization was not launched, so no Lean proof or substrate promotion is claimed; singleton lower rates, phase coefficients, broader-class attainment, and practical finite-size calibration remain open.
tldr: A public deterministic cap on potentially missing outcomes creates a sharp detection frontier for the whole finite-population causal effect in monotone binary trials under balanced complete randomization. With \(k=n-m\), the unrestricted full-record minimax power at \(s=m+\lceil h\sqrt k\rceil\) converges to \(P_\star(h)=\Phi(h-z_{1-\alpha})\). One total midpoint permutation rule has finite level exactly \(\alpha=1/20\) and attains this limit uniformly across all reporting densities. Legal fixed-table fair-bit priors certify the all-test ceiling. A terminating rational algorithm certifies an \(O_{\mathcal H}(k^{-1/2})\) finite-effective-size envelope on every rational compact positive interval, including singletons; the \(\Theta_{\mathcal H}(k^{-1/2})\) order is sharp on every positive-length interval. Only singleton matching lower rates and phase-specific leading coefficients remain open. These equalities and attainment statements concern the novel maintained unitwise monotone capped model, a strict specialization of the broader reporting frameworks.
gap: Exact missing-outcome testing and completion methods provide validity without characterizing optimal worst-table detection under a deterministic potential-arm reporting cap.
fill: The theorem matches a legal full-record converse to one finite-valid procedure. An exact rational count-game example exposes finite information lost by scalar-only testing; quantitative legal-table and lattice Handles isolate the open sharp finite-size approximation.
